rows.contract: The selected macOS SDK must supply native Metal 4 queue, command buffer, allocator, compiler, argument tables and residency declarations under ARC.
rows.native_mapping: Compile and link an ARM64 Objective-C++20 configure probe using SDK frameworks. It is not executed during configuration.
rows.expected_result: Current SDK links successfully; unavailable declarations or ARC produce a hard, specific configuration failure.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: The SDK exposes native object/mesh declarations. Physical feature support is queried separately.
rows.native_mapping: Compile SDK declarations and build object/mesh MSL4 directly. GPU output is verified by the separate smoke fixture.
rows.expected_result: Native object/mesh MSL compiles. On hardware supporting the fixture, pixel at (1,1) equals RGBA (255,0,0,255).
rows.actual_result: Native compile/link passed. No process-visible Metal device, so hardware output was not verified.

rows.contract: MetalFX Spatial exposes a Metal 4 creation and capability route.
rows.native_mapping: Validate the MTL4FXSpatialScaler protocol and command buffer encoding type at configure time. Run deterministic native output on GPU if available.
rows.expected_result: SDK link works. On a capable device the RGBA (255,0,0,255) input scales to the same expected output pixel.
rows.actual_result: Native compile/link passed. No process-visible Metal device, so hardware output was not verified.

rows.contract: Metal 4 declarations are available at macOS 26.0; unrelated builds keep their existing deployment parameters.
rows.native_mapping: Use an opt-in scope and a 26.0 floor with explicit validation before checking SDK declarations.
rows.expected_result: 26.0 and 26.1 configure successfully; 15.0 fails with the deployment diagnostic.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: An SDK without usable declarations or a compiler without ARC must fail before consumers build.
rows.native_mapping: Use the real configure-time compile/link test and inject a forced header error on a fresh and cached build.
rows.expected_result: Both injected failures are rejected. Removing the injected failure from the same cache allows successful reconfiguration.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: A physical Metal 4 GPU, command submission, shared output and API validation are distinct from compilation.
rows.native_mapping: Run the existing native-only fixture. Absent device leaves the GPU check pending and does not block CMake.
rows.expected_result: Metal API validation is enabled; shared memory readback equals 0x4d544c34 with no validation errors.
rows.actual_result: Native compile/link passed. No process-visible Metal device, so hardware output was not verified.

rows.contract: GPU capture requires an accessible Metal GPU and writable output.
rows.native_mapping: Run native fixture with MTL_CAPTURE_ENABLED and save workload.gputrace, preserving an exact trigger if unavailable.
rows.expected_result: A GPU trace is created and readable after successful native workload submission.
rows.actual_result: Native compile/link passed. No process-visible Metal device, so hardware output was not verified.

rows.contract: CMake opt-in must preserve shared CPU-side PICA200 behavior.
rows.native_mapping: Build and run real test target and standalone [video_core] suite with Vulkan disabled.
rows.expected_result: PICA baseline remains 48 cases and 801 assertions. CTest passes available cases and independently reports fixture skips.
rows.actual_result: Fresh project link and PICA tests passed: 48 cases and 801 assertions. CTest passed 64 and skipped 5.

rows.contract: CMake enables native sources and SDK checks but actual settings.cpp and Qt frontend compile commands omit ENABLE_METAL; native settings selectors and conditional bridge would be inactive.
rows.native_mapping: Publish ENABLE_METAL to actual targets only after successful native mode and Apple SDK checks.
rows.expected_result: Native settings and Qt compile actual conditional code; off mode lacks modifier, native dependency graph has no Vulkan unit. PICA 48/801 and 64 CTest.
rows.command: cmake configure, SDK probe, build native tests and native Qt consumers
rows.actual_result: SDK arm64 ARC check and full native target rebuild; actual -DENABLE_METAL in settings and Qt compile commands; native GetWorkingGraphicsAPI/default Spatial and Software verified by linked fixture; off graph unchanged; no Vulkan compilation; PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes plus 5 existing skips.

rows.contract: The same native Qt Apple bridge is compiled by both citra_qt and citra_meta without ARC, which is incompatible with the retained Metal device handles returned by the ARC native platform interface.
rows.native_mapping: Enable ARC only on the existing Metal Qt bridge in its two source-owning target directories when ENABLE_METAL is selected.
rows.expected_result: Both native actual compile entries use ARC, opt-out remains independent, native SDK and regression continue to pass.
rows.command: cmake configure Qt and native tests; compile exact source entry
rows.actual_result: Native SDK configure succeeded and both actual Qt/Meta compile entries include ARC exactly once and ENABLE_METAL. Native-only per-source flag, no Vulkan units; real Qt bridge compile and link evidence follows in 079.

rows.contract: Native MetalARC bridge belongs to the Qt target alone.
rows.native_mapping: Remove the broad inherited root ARC property after ownership moves to citra_qt private build registration. Preserve native backend option and platform framework checks.
rows.expected_result: Compiler graph contains one Qt Objective-C++ ARC bridge, legacy feature-off Apple source registrations are unchanged, build and regression evidence passes.
rows.actual_result: Verified native/off Qt graph, role-local ARC and complete native target link.
